corpus_sweep.instrument: docs/features/castwiden/semhunks.py over docs/features/castwiden/semrun.py output (kuna decompile-all --json --option structdefs on; castwiden off vs the default, one build 07d37d9ba)
corpus_sweep.rule: each changed line is parsed as C on both sides (casts found by castcount's grammar with the file's own type vocabulary); the trees must be equal once casts are set aside (GROUPING otherwise); no cast may be added (ADDED), removed from anything but an 8-byte integer cast (SCOPE), removed under a shift, comparison or unary op (FORBIDDEN), or removed from both operands of one op (BOTH_LOST); every removed cast is typed from the function's declarations, struct definitions and signatures: under + - * / % & | ^ the op must keep its type, or at 64 bits inside a chain of + - * & | ^ the chain must end with the same type; a destination must be the cast's type or an 8-byte integer (NARROW otherwise); anything whose type the text does not state is UNVERIFIED and listed
